theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} (h : s ⋖ t) : s.card ⋖ t.card := by
  have h_subset : s ⊆ t := h.1
  have h_neq : s ≠ t := h.2
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := h.2 s t
  refine lt_of_not_ge _ 
  rintro h_card_eq
  apply h_neq
  rw [h_card_eq]
  exact eq.trans (card_eq_iff_finite_eq.1 h_card_eq) (eq.symm (finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_eq h_subset h_card_eq))
